chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from al-Ḥalabī, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about one who practices mufakhkhaḏah: is ghusl obligatory upon him? He said: Yes, if he ejaculates.

key_terms.إِذَا: indicating the condition upon which the ruling depends
key_terms.الْمُفَخِّذِ: one engaging in thighing or intercrural sexual contact
key_terms.غُسْلٌ: the ritual bath required after major ritual impurity

ai.seo_question: Does ejaculation make ghusl obligatory even in cases other than intercourse?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that the خروج of maniyy necessitates ghusl in every circumstance, including in the case mentioned here. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that ghusl becomes obligatory when ejaculation occurs.
